title: Index Price Loading for Index-Priced C&I Structures at the Anniversary Review
content:
**Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts - anniversary security review: index price loading.**

The review requirement carries an index price loading: on a structure whose energy is priced as index plus adder or as fixed block plus index balance, an index kWh share of 0.15 or more, meaning the kWh on index energy charge lines posted in the review window divided by all kWh posted on supply lines in the window, gives a loading of 1.15, and a smaller index kWh share on such a structure gives 1.05; any other structure carries no loading. The loading multiplies the review requirement.

| Structure | Energy priced as | Loading |
|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge C&I Real-Time Index | index plus adder | 1.15 at an index kWh share of 0.15 or more, otherwise 1.05 |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Block and Index | fixed block plus index balance | 1.15 at an index kWh share of 0.15 or more, otherwise 1.05 |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity and Transmission Pass-Through | fixed | none |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity Pass-Through | fixed | none |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In | fixed | none |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In Renewable | fixed | none |

The review window is the twelve months before the handling date, by posted date. When no kWh at all were posted in the window, the index kWh share is taken as zero.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Structure | Index kWh in the window | All kWh in the window | Share | Loading |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Block and Index | 540000 | 3600000 | 0.15 | 1.15 |
| Block and Index | 500000 | 3600000 | 0.139 | 1.05 |
| Real-Time Index | 2900000 | 2900000 | 1.00 | 1.15 |
| Fixed All-In | none | 3600000 | not used | none |
